Roll — Terms of Use

Last updated: 17 August 2026

The agreement

By using Roll you agree to these terms. If you do not, do not use the app.

What Roll is

A food and body-composition tracker that estimates your energy and macronutrient needs and helps you log against them.

What Roll is not

Roll is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Its targets come from population formulas refined by your own logged data, and every estimate carries error. Do not use Roll to manage a medical condition without professional supervision. Do not use it to pursue rapid or extreme weight loss. If you have or suspect an eating disorder, please speak to a qualified professional.

Estimates from photo and text analysis are approximations. Verify anything that matters.

Your account

You are responsible for your account credentials and for the accuracy of what you enter. You must be old enough to form a binding contract in your country, and at least 13 (16 in some regions).

Subscriptions

Roll offers an optional paid subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID, renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends, and is managed in your Apple ID settings. Refunds are handled by Apple under their policy, not by us.

Acceptable use

Do not attempt to break, overload, reverse-engineer or gain unauthorised access to the service, and do not use it to store unlawful content.

Availability

Roll depends on services we do not control, and features may change or be withdrawn. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.

Liability

To the extent permitted by law, Roll is provided "as is". Nothing in these terms limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, for fraud, or for anything else that cannot lawfully be excluded.

Ending it

You may stop using Roll and delete your account at any time from Profile → Settings → Account & data. We may suspend accounts that breach these terms.

Roll — the same document the app bundles, so the two cannot drift apart.
